basis.governing_question: What strategy should Banco Horizonte adopt for its digital channels?

sub_questions.question: How do customers use Banco Horizonte's digital channels today, and how well do those channels perform?
What do the CEO and Head of Digital need the digital channels to deliver?
What do Portuguese retail banking customers expect from digital channels, and what do competitors offer?
Which role and priorities should each digital channel have in Banco Horizonte's strategy?
What roadmap sequences the strategy's initiatives, and who owns each one?

work.unit: Interview round with one stakeholder group
Digital channel baseline: usage, customer journeys and performance

phase_work.why: Both stakeholder groups are interviewed in one round, then usage and journey data is analyzed; one week of start-up and one of synthesis.

work.unit: Customer segment researched on digital needs and behavior
Benchmark of competitor digital channel offers

phase_work.why: The three segments are researched side by side, then competitors are benchmarked; one synthesis week closes the phase.

work.unit: Digital channel strategy and priorities defined

phase_work.why: The strategy and priorities are defined first, then sequenced into a roadmap with owners; one synthesis week closes the phase.

sizing.levers: Running customer research and the competitor benchmark side by side, or baselining only the most-used channels, would shorten the engagement most.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish how customers use Banco Horizonte's digital channels today, where journeys break down, and how the channels perform.

gate.label: Gaps to pursue
gate.decision: Which digital channel gaps go forward into the customer and competitor research?

phases.name: Research
phases.objective_one_line: Gather evidence on what retail banking customers expect from digital channels and what competitors offer in Portugal.

gate.label: Options to design
gate.decision: Which customer segments and channel options go forward into the strategy design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the digital channel strategy for Banco Horizonte, with priorities, target role of each channel and a sequenced roadmap.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Does the steering group approve the final digital channel strategy and roadmap?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given: the 12 to 18 weeks are an estimate summed from the work in each phase, to confirm before quoting.
No library archetype fits a digital channel strategy; only the stakeholder interview round comes from the library, all other work units are estimates.
